name: Corn RNA aptamer bound to DFHO
preparationNotes: Initial runnable preparation uses RNA chain Y and ligand 747 (DFHO) chain Y from RCSB PDB 5BJP. The PDB contains two RNA chains (E and Y); only chain Y bears the DFHO ligand. All crystallographic ions (IR iridium hexammine soaking/phasing agent, K potassium, MG magnesium, DMS dimethyl sulfoxide) were removed for this first MacVina stacking-focused case. Open Babel 3.1.0 generated PDBQT files with preserved atom names; ligand torsions had 2 active rotatable bonds.
source: RCSB PDB 5BJP; HARIBOSS RNA-small-molecule complex example.
notes: HARIBOSS expansion case promoted to parsed with local ignored PDBQT inputs. Ligand 747 is DFHO, a fluorogenic dye-like heteroaromatic ligand bound specifically to RNA chain Y (PDB chain Y residue 104). Chain E is a crystallographic dimer without ligand. Use as a fluorogenic aptamer base-stacking benchmark alongside 6C64-mango-ii-ekm.
